question:
**Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the following word.**

Viable
solution:
The correct answer is **"Feasible".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Viable' **is often used to describe projects, plans, proposals, or ideas that are practical and can be achieved or executed effectively. (ऐसी परियोजनाएँ, योजनाएँ, प्रस्ताव या विचार जो व्यावहारिक हों और जिन्हें प्रभावी ढंग से प्राप्त या क्रियान्वित किया जा सके)
 
• The meaning of words can shift depending on context, but in most usages, **'viable' **describes something capable of surviving or living successfully, especially under particular environmental conditions.
 
• 
 
**"Feasible"** - An idea, plan, or method that is feasible can be done or achieved. Hence, it is synonymous with 'viable'. (कोई विचार, योजना या तरीका जो व्यवहार्य हो उसे पूरा किया या हासिल किया जा सकता है)

 
 
• 
 
When something is both viable and feasible, it's practically doable or achievable given the circumstances or resources.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **"Formidable" - **This term means very powerful or impressive, and causing you to have fear or respect for something or someone. (बहुत शक्तिशाली या प्रभावशाली, और किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति के प्रति आपके मन में डर या सम्मान पैदा करने वाला)
 
• **"Disposable" - **This refers to something that is designed for or capable of being thrown away after being used or used up. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो उपयोग या उपयोग के बाद फेंके जाने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई हो या सक्षम हो)
 
• **"Insatiable" -** This word typically refers to an appetite or desire that is impossible to satisfy or quench. (ऐसी भूख या इच्छा जिसे तृप्त करना या बुझाना असंभव हो)
